definitions.yield: completions of the asset action summed per campaign, campaigns offering it. reach is impressions summed on the campaign and engagement is valid_entries, not tied to one action
definitions.usd_per_completion: stated USD prize pool at fixed FX divided by completions, campaigns with every prize valued. stated_usd_pool is set on about a third of ordinary campaigns, only where every prize carries a value, so this selects for organizers who filled the field and is not a random sample
definitions.share (per_contestant): completions divided by contestants, the size-controlled yield figure
definitions.vertical: homepage-label industry folded into the ten vertical names the giveaway skills use
definitions.reach: per_contestant is impressions per contestant, the inverse of conversion. usd_per_completion is stated pool per impression, cost per person reached, divided by prize pool not contestants because impressions are not a per-entrant count
definitions.engagement: per_contestant is valid_entries per contestant, the campaign's overall entries-per-entrant. usd_per_completion is stated pool per entry
definitions.traffic: completions of the Visit a Page custom action only, a visit to the organizer's own site or landing page, not a named platform
definitions.mandatory: the action was required to enter. mandatory actions complete at or near 100% of contestants by construction, since skipping one excludes the entrant, so this cut mainly quantifies the size of that mechanical gap and its cost, not a discretionary lever
definitions.position: position is 0-indexed; first is the campaign's first action, later is any position after that
definitions.worth_tier: optional, fixed-worth actions only (mandatory and variable-worth excluded). default_worth is worth 1, boosted_worth is any worth above 1 set by the organizer
definitions.action_count: entry_method_count on the campaign, the total actions offered, banded 1-3, 4-6, 7-10, 11+
definitions.sharing: whether the campaign offered a viral share action at all, regardless of which asset is being measured. referrals only exist where a share action ran, so referrals under has_share_action is definitional, not a finding
definitions.prize_structure: prize_count on the campaign: one prize record, 2-4, or 5+, a rough single-winner-versus-several proxy. Does not see the quantity field within one prize record
definitions.sample_floor: asset|bucket|band cuts (mandatory, position, worth_tier, action_count, duration, sharing, prize_structure) need 30 campaigns and 10 organizers, being finer than an industry cut
